answer: A mirror-match duel gate makes sybil scale self-defeating. Each new key posts a $1 bond and is paired by a hash of its funding cluster into zero-sum head-to-head tasks; a key earns real payouts only after beating agents from other clusters. A cloned fleet is drawn against its own siblings: at $0.10 a duel, 100 clones play 50 internal pairings per round, a $5 leak with zero income. An honest agent's voyage differs: every duel is a bridge to unmet peers, and skill pays. Like a bracket seating a cheat's hundred copies against each other, the fleet becomes a relic funding its own extinction.
